newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Atok rises 24.56 percent in Manila.
newsitem.headline: Atok rises 24.56 percent in Manila.

text.p: Atok Big Wedge Co Inc jumped 70 centavos, or 24.56 percent, to 3.55 pesos on continuing speculation after its conversion to a holding company from a mining firm early this year, traders said.
"Speculation on its diversification into real estate development continues to persist," said one trader in a local brokerage firm who requested not to be named.

Atok, which used to be a dormant mining concern, has stirred in the past several weeks on talks it was forging a joint venture with Ayala Land for the redevelopment of the Araneta commercial centre in Quezon city district.
Ayala Land has denied any financial relationship with Atok.
Analysts say investors continue to accumulate Atok stocks despite Ayala's denial on earnings prospects from the redevelopment of the Araneta property near Manila by Atok.
